profile.title: Profile
profile.description: Your name and avatar are shared across all Ortelius products. Edit them once in the central account portal and the changes propagate everywhere.

leaveOrganization.title: Leave organization
leaveOrganization.description: Leaving {{organizationName}} will revoke your access to its data, members, and messages. Any requests assigned to you will be unassigned. This action cannot be undone.

dialog.title: Leave {{organizationName}}?
dialog.description: You will lose access to this organization, its members, requests, and messages. Any requests currently assigned to you will be unassigned. This action cannot be undone.
